claims: Bryce Harper was born on October 16, 1992.
Bryce Harper is a first baseman and right fielder for the Philadelphia Phillies.
Bryce Harper has been with the Philadelphia Phillies since 2019.
Bryce Harper's contract is signed through 2031.
Bryce Harper was selected #1 overall in the 2010 MLB Draft by the Washington Nationals.
Bryce Harper won NL Rookie of the Year in 2012 with the Washington Nationals.
Bryce Harper won his first NL MVP in 2015 at age 22.
Bryce Harper won his second NL MVP in 2021 with the Philadelphia Phillies.
Bryce Harper has won 4 Silver Slugger awards.
Bryce Harper has hit over 300 career home runs.
Bryce Harper made his MLB debut at age 19 in 2012.
Bryce Harper led the Philadelphia Phillies to the 2022 World Series.
Bryce Harper won NLCS MVP in 2022.
Bryce Harper transitioned to first base full-time following 2023 elbow surgery.
Bryce Harper finished the 2025 season with a .261 batting average.
Bryce Harper hit 27 home runs in the 2025 season.
Bryce Harper had 75 RBI in the 2025 season
